description: Main window: core, close after the unsaved-changes prompt, Open/Save dialogs, and read/write of picked files. Fs allows are additive: home, Desktop, Documents, Downloads, legacy drive-letter globs, dialog picks, exact launch files and exact balloon sidecars. C:/Windows/Fonts/*.ttf adds binary read access; both enabled write commands explicitly deny the Fonts folder and its contents. The sidecar command verifies the source is already allowed; no sibling folder grant.
